info.name: Total Expert Public Account Endpoints Heartbeat API

items.docs: The API will respond with a heartbeat with a string describing the running item. Useful for testing routing and API status.

Checks whether the API is a teapot. Should return '418 - IM A TEAPOT'. This is, naturally, protected information. You will need to authenticate with the API in order to check whether the API is a teapot.

This endpoint is useful for testing whether your authentication credentials are correct, particularly when first integrating with the TE API.
